Package org.aeonbits.owner.validation

package org.aeonbits.owner.validation
The seam through which a Bean Validation provider checks a configuration, and the vocabulary the core uses to talk about constraints without depending on a validation API.

The core recognises a constraint annotation by name and can therefore say that one is there; it cannot check it, which needs javax.validation or jakarta.validation and a provider. That work is done by a ConfigValidator found on the class path - owner-extras ships one - and everything in this package exists so that the two can talk.
